Name: Bot Auto Hack
Description:
[h2]Bot Auto Hack[/h2]

Ever watched a boarding raid deliver a collection of hostile robots, sent each one a carefully individualized intrusion, and discovered that Core had quietly installed a global recruitment brake? Bot Auto Hack has reviewed the new terms and negotiated a compromise.

Bot Auto Hack queues eligible hostile robotic Beings and gives each one its own ordinary Stardeus Hack attempt, one per simulation tick. It preserves Core's per-bot seed, global conversion cooldown, condition lifecycle, and burnout consequences while turning Core's harmless 30% failure result into a transparent conversion floor.

[h2]Features[/h2]

[h3]Individual Hack Dispatch[/h3]
- Automatically finds and queues eligible hostile robotic Beings
- Provides a manual Hack All Hostile Bots command while automation is off
- Redirects Core's multi-selection Hack click into the same individual queue
- Starts at most one accepted Core Hack per simulation tick
- Revalidates every target immediately before dispatch
- Waits while the simulation is paused

[h3]Transparent Conversion Policy[/h3]
Current Core gives hostile Signal Intrusion attempts a 30% harmless failure result, then sends the remaining 70% through a global curve based on days since any hostile bot last converted. Bot Auto Hack reassigns only that harmless branch to conversion.

- 0 days since the last conversion: 30% conversion / 70% burnout
- 1 day: 33.5% conversion / 66.5% burnout
- 3 days: 44% conversion / 56% burnout
- 7+ days or no previous conversion: 54.5% conversion / 45.5% burnout

Every conversion still resets Core's global timestamp. The cooldown therefore continues to reduce rapid recruitment, but sustained raids no longer create a guaranteed zero-conversion window. The mod validates the audited Core calculation, first-roll branch, 30% tunable, and curve anchors at startup. If Core changes that contract, the override fails closed instead of silently presenting different odds.

[h3]Control and Status[/h3]
- Requires the existing Rogue AI Signal Intrusion research
- Starts with automatic hacking disabled and stores the setting with the save
- Shows the current number of living robotic Beings carrying Core's Hacked condition below the top-bar widget
- Keeps active hacks, pending targets, started and skipped attempts, and recent activity visible in the controls panel
- Saves pending target IDs and request sources
- Uses AUMF's stable native widget and panel controls

[h3]Firewall Chip Handling[/h3]
- Makes Hack unavailable for bots protected by a working Firewall Chip
- Provides a separate Firewall-removal toggle that starts disabled and operates only while main automation is on
- Orders removal only for living, active, hostile, incapacitated robots with a removable working chip in the Implant slot
- Skips welded slots, conflicting surgery orders, and targets without a suitable vanilla surgery facility
- Registers Stardeus's ordinary Remove operation; the mod never removes or damages the implant directly
- Leaves accepted operations visible and cancelable through the vanilla Surgeries interface

[h2]Safety and Core Ownership[/h2]

Bot Auto Hack considers only active, non-biological Being entities. Ships, colonies, biological Beings, dead or inactive targets, friendly robots, coreless bodies, bots already being hacked, and robots protected by a working Firewall Chip remain outside the queue. Ship and colony hacking paths are never inspected or patched.

Every dispatched target still goes through Stardeus's normal single-target Hack action. Core retains the per-bot outcome seed, Hacked-condition duration, Firewall protection, mind/core requirement, secondary cooldown curve, global saved conversion timestamp, faction change, irreparable burnout damage, and death behavior. The separate Virus outcome for player-owned robots is untouched.

[h2]Requirements[/h2]

Requires [b]Stardeus 0.15.0[/b] (validated on [b]v0.15.19.3268[/b]), [b]Auto Utilities Mod Framework 1.4.0[/b], and the existing Rogue AI [b]Signal Intrusion[/b] research. Firewall removal additionally requires an appropriate vanilla surgery facility.

[h2]In Short[/h2]

Core keeps the cooldown and the consequences. Bot Auto Hack makes the odds visible and guarantees that every attempt starts with a real chance.

[b]Thirty percent now. Fifty-four and a half when patience pays.[/b]
